- Workstream: Local / Remote / Integration / Architecture
- Base SHA（完整 40 位）:

- 实际修改文件:

- Final HEAD SHA:
- Branch validation:
- Flutter regression:

- PR required gate:
- 其他必要检查与 run / job 链接:

- 是否需要 Find N2 实机: YES / NO
- 状态: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / DEVICE MISSING / UNKNOWN / NOT REQUIRED
- 测试构建 SHA:
- APK versionName / versionCode:
- APK SHA-256:
- 设备 / Android / ColorOS:
- E4B 模型版本与 SHA-256:
- 实际后端: GPU / CPU / UNKNOWN
- 场景 ID 与脱敏证据路径:
- 重测范围 / 未解决项:
